tensorize_XLM_texts: tensorize a batch of multilingual texts into token, language, and position tensors using ScriptXLMTensorizer
tokenize_XLM_text_row: tokenize a row of multilingual text strings into per-sentence token and language tuples
numberize_XLM_tokens: numberize multilingual text or token rows into token IDs, language IDs, sequence length, and positions
lookup_XLM_token_ids: lookup token and language IDs from token and language tuples using vocabularies and max sequence length
review_ScriptXLMTensorizer_class: review the ScriptXLMTensorizer class for TorchScript-compatible XLM multilingual text tensorization with token and language vocabularies
